workflow.name: Recall-First External Flow Security Review v2.6
workflow.description: A short, branch-preserving security workflow based on OpenKritt's proven external-flow-analysis shape. It maps production entrypoints, traces materially distinct flows, then applies independent adversarial lenses directly to each flow. Technical candidates are emitted before deduplication, reproduction, severity, or bounty-program eligibility checks so those precision stages cannot erase discovery recall.

steps.name: Map every externally influenced production surface
Trace distinct flows, transitions, and alternate sequences
Attack identity, authorization, and protocol state
Attack parsing, canonicalization, and crash boundaries
Attack accounting, consensus, and cross-component invariants
